name: scos-memory-fabric-cowork
description: Connects Claude Cowork to the SCOS Memory Fabric via the mcp-gateway service, exposing scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct and scos_forget through a single scos-memory skill.

gateway_url.title: mcp-gateway URL
gateway_url.description: The web address of your SCOS Memory Fabric server (the mcp-gateway service). Ask whoever set up your SCOS deployment for this URL.

bearer_token.title: SCOS bearer token
bearer_token.description: Your login credential (like a password) for the SCOS server, proving Claude Cowork is allowed to connect. Get one from whoever administers your SCOS deployment.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Identifies which organization's/workspace's data you're allowed to see on a shared SCOS server (like a company/workspace ID) — memories are isolated per tenant so one tenant can never read another's. Get it from whoever administers your SCOS deployment; it's not something you choose yourself.

principal_id.title: Principal ID
principal_id.description: Identifies you (or this agent identity) within the tenant above — like a username, used so memories can be attributed to a specific caller. Get it from whoever administers your SCOS deployment.
